body: <sf-chart-timeline id="s" label="Состояние сервисов" row="service" start="from" end="to" status="state" row-label="Сервис" table="hidden"></sf-chart-timeline>

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by the rows, the ranges and the span, the longest range, the status that takes the most time and the milestones; a bar per range in a group of its status's colour, a diamond for the milestone, the rows' names at the start and the statuses in the key
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.row, settings.start, settings.end, settings.status, settings.summary, settings.legend
